title: AI Video Generators After Sora: Choose the Right Replacement
summary: Find an AI video workflow after Sora’s discontinuation. Compare cinematic clips, presenters and narrated explanations, then test your own brief.
body_markdown:
Need a cinematic product shot, a presenter reading a script, or a narrated lesson with diagrams? Those are three different replacement jobs after Sora. This guide compares the starting material and finished output for each, then shows how to test a one-minute explainer in Golpo before choosing a production plan.


*Published by Golpo AI, one of the products discussed. Updated November 23, 2026. Product descriptions are based on official documentation, not a controlled quality ranking.*


## Sora's discontinuation dates


OpenAI says the Sora web and app experiences ended on **April 26, 2026** , and the Sora API ended on **September 24, 2026** . Its[official discontinuation guidance](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001152-what-to-know-about-the-sora-discontinuation) also explains available content-export steps. Follow that source for your account rather than relying on an old comparison table or speculation about a future relaunch.


For a new project, choose a currently available workflow. If another site lists a model with a familiar name, verify the actual provider, availability, usage terms, and export behavior in that product. A name on a marketing page does not establish continued access to OpenAI's discontinued service.


## Match the replacement to the output


Finished output Candidates to evaluate What to test first


Cinematic shot or generated B-roll Runway, Google Veo workflows, Kling, Hailuo Motion, reference consistency, audio, clip length, and assembly effort


Presenter-led message or translated speaker video HeyGen or Synthesia Likeness, pronunciation, consent, localization, and scene controls


Narrated visual explanation Golpo Script accuracy, drawn relationships, readable labels, and corrections


Editable business animation Vyond or Animaker Character actions, scene control, revisions, and the final export


Footage-led social video or repurposed article Pictory or InVideo Source fidelity, generated or stock media, captions, and editing effort


These are starting points for a trial. Products now combine multiple workflows, so do not assume that every avatar tool lacks generated visuals or every editor requires a blank timeline. The[broader AI video guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/best-ai-video-generator-2026) compares buying requirements across categories.


## When you need cinematic footage


Begin with the shot: subject, action, framing, camera movement, duration, and any source image. Run a small test that includes the hardest motion in your actual brief. Check object continuity and the first and last frames, then see how the clip fits the surrounding edit.


[Runway](https://runway.com/) combines video generation with a wider creative workspace.[Google's Veo](https://deepmind.google/models/veo/) is a video-generation model accessed through Google's supported products and developer offerings.[Kling](https://klingai.com/) and[Hailuo](https://hailuoai.video/) are additional candidates for motion-focused work. Model, resolution, duration, queue, and product access affect cost. Confirm the live configuration rather than transferring an old Sora rate to another provider.


If the deliverable is a minute-long explanation, a good five-second clip is only one input. You still need a script, narration, visual continuity, assembly, and review. Use the[cost-per-minute worksheet](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/ai-video-pricing-exposed-true-cost-per-minute) to price that full job.


## When the speaker is central


[HeyGen](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) and[Synthesia](https://www.synthesia.io/pricing) document avatar creation and language workflows. Evaluate them when a presenter delivering the message is central to the brief. Use an authorized likeness and voice, test specialist names, and review each translated version.


Golpo can also place a stock Avatar or photo-based AI Presenter beside its drawings. Creator and higher, plus Pay As You Go, include that workflow at **2 credits per minute** for either presenter type. Use it when the face supports the explanation.[Picture in Picture](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-picture-in-picture-guide) is the separate route for keeping an actual recorded speaker visible; a generated presenter is not a recording.


## When the audience needs to understand a process


Suppose your video explains the difference between a support request being received, assigned, and resolved. The useful visual is the relationship between those stages, including what happens when an issue reopens. A scenic clip alone will not teach that sequence.


In Golpo, start from the process document or an approved script. Choose Canvas for a diagrammed treatment or Sketch for drawn whiteboard scenes. Approve the words, render, then check whether the right stage is visible while it is explained. The[AI whiteboard evaluation guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/best-ai-whiteboard-video-generators-2026) includes that exact support-flow brief, with Script, Video Instructions, and Voice Instructions kept separate.


The[examples gallery](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/ai-explainer-video-examples) shows actual videos made from prompts, scripts, recordings, and custom styles. Those examples demonstrate output formats; they are not a speed or quality comparison with other products.


## Test a one-minute explainer in Golpo


1. **Choose one narrow topic.** For example, explain why a reopened support ticket returns to its owner instead of becoming an unrelated request.
2. **Add the source.** Paste a short approved script or attach the relevant document. Say who the viewer is and what they should understand afterward.
3. **Review the narration.** Use Edit script before creating video when Golpo drafts the words. Use Script Mode for approved wording.
4. **Pick the visual treatment.** Keep a simple drawing style and a single purpose for each scene. Use a plan that includes the controls you need.
5. **Watch the result against the source.** Check wording, sequence, labels, pronunciation, and timing. A finished render still needs this review.


The Free plan is one one-minute watermarked preview with no download and no card required. A downloadable black-and-white Canvas/Sketch workflow starts at Starter, $39.99 monthly with 20 credits and a two-minute per-video cap. This is a way to evaluate Golpo; free limits for other products are different and should be checked on their own current pages.


## Check the plan and engine before scaling


Canvas and Sketch use one credit per minute. Golpo Studio, available from Growth, uses one credit per 30 seconds. Both stock and photo presenters use two credits per minute. Color begins at Growth; Voice Instructions and vertical output begin at Creator. Own Narration, voice cloning, own media, and Custom Style are included from Business and on Pay As You Go.


Pay As You Go starts at $399 for 100 credits. API Only has a $200 minimum commitment and is separate from dashboard generation. The[pricing breakdown](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-ai-full-pricing-breakdown) and[live pricing page](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) explain the current options.


The first edited version is free on Starter and higher and Pay As You Go. The editor offers visual changes and Edit Audio; review the[editing guide](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-video-editing-guide) before estimating later revised versions.


## Frequently asked questions


### Can I still start a new Sora project?


OpenAI's official notice says its web/app and API services have been discontinued. Use the linked notice for current export information and choose a currently offered product for new production.


### Is Golpo a cinematic replacement for Sora?


Golpo's core workflow produces narrated illustrated and whiteboard explanations. Evaluate it for lessons, training, product education, and process videos. For a specific photorealistic moving shot, test a cinematic video workflow against that shot.


### Can I keep using my existing scripts and recordings?


Approved scripts can be reused in Script Mode. Own Narration, on Business and higher and Pay As You Go, uses an authorized recording to drive new visuals. Keep your original project files and permitted exports as well; editable projects do not automatically transfer between vendors.


### Which replacement is best?


The one that produces your required file with acceptable review effort and cost. Compare two suitable candidates on the same brief, preserve the first results, and decide from the files you can actually use.
